content_zh:
“莫非是刺史大人与董卓这逆贼撕破脸后，将军感到焦虑？不然也不会从马上摔下来。”
“噤声，将军来了，文远，你看，将军竟然在笑。”曹性一脸惊奇的看着越走越近的吕布，心头闪过一丝疑云，吕布带军向来严谨、苛刻，尤其是随刺史大人一同奉命进京之后，从未见他笑过，连带着曹性好动的性格也收敛了不少。
“将军。”张辽、曹性急忙抱拳道。
“哦，你们两个在这嘀嘀咕咕干什么呢？”脸上挂着淡淡笑容的吕布一瘸一拐的走了过来，步伐虽然有些艰难却依旧铿锵有力。
“将军，您的伤势痊愈了？”见曹性一时间没反应过来，张辽急忙问道。
“一点小伤，没事没事，我受伤后军中的情况还好吧？你们要抓紧训练士卒；对了，那些受伤的士兵一定要照顾好。”吕布交待了一番之后，向着练武场的方向走去。
张辽曹性对视一眼，尽皆可以看到对方眼中的疑惑不解，虽然几人都是从捏泥巴都开始认识的，但吕布在他们眼中一直都是高傲、不可战胜的，在他的身上有一种天下非吾对手的霸气，而他们也心甘情愿跟着吕布，没想到就这么几天的功夫，吕布就像是换了一个人一样，以前漠不关心的士兵，他竟然也会亲自过问，话也变得多了起来，这可是一个天大的消息。
不过这样的转变毕竟是好的，两人都以为经过多次的战斗之后，吕布的心性变得越来越成熟了，殊不知，眼前的吕布虽然还是那具身体，灵魂却是来自一千多年后。
作为一名华夏特种兵，面对强敌追剿，无奈之下只能选择跳崖，本以为必死，却没想到阴差阳错来到了大汉朝最为混乱的年代，而且还成为了第一猛将吕布，兴奋随即让无奈占据。
论身体的强壮程度，前世的自己是无论如何也比不了的，不过想着身份的转变、时代的不同，枪炮换成了刀戟，车辆换成了战马，还是有些接受不了，吕布记忆里的招式虽然还在，在他眼中却是有些怪异，毕竟这是用那么长的兵器杀人，这不，为了尽快熟悉身体，他试图练练骑术，没想到马上将军却跑到了马下，闹了一个大笑话。
从沿途所见士兵的眼中，吕布看到了崇敬、狂热，士兵的训练虽然在他看来有些怪异，却是那么的刻苦，很少有人偷懒。
深夜，吕布手里拿着之前闲置在案上的《春秋》，就着烛光，津津有味的看着，在他眼中，古代的书籍实在是太过于笨重了，看这上面的小故事聊作消遣还是可以的，至于晦涩难懂的地方直接被他过滤了。
“启禀将军，刺史大人已到帐外。”卫兵进帐低声说道。
“刺史大人。”吕布闻言不敢怠慢，急忙迎了出去。
“奉先，听军士说你骑马受了伤，无碍吧？”丁原关切的问道。
“没什么事，一些小伤，休息一下就好了，这么晚了，大人还没休息？”吕布还是习惯不了古代人说话文绉绉的语调，还好吕布本身就是一员武将，在别人听来自然没有什么纰漏。
丁原约有五十岁上下，说起话来，脸上似乎带着笑容，给人一种亲切感。
看着眼前的丁原，吕布也是百感交集，记忆中，这位刺史大人对待自己是很不错的，一直着力培养自己，还让自己在军队中训练骑兵，是并州军中切实的二把手。
“嗯，明日与董军还会有一场恶战，奉先就不必参与了，好好养伤，待来日助为父击破董贼，清君侧，振我大汉朝纲。”言及此处，丁原的脸上满是愤怒和一丝期待，对于臣子来说，最大的荣耀莫过于此了。
“大人，董军人数远超我军，而且有雒阳城为守，我军从并州而来，粮草运输很不方便，长时间下去，恐怕会有变，不如早做决断。”吕布劝道。

“哦，以奉先之见该当如何？”丁原眼前一亮，以前的吕布只知道战场冲杀、训练军士，何曾想过如此深入的问题。
“大人，末将认为我军当退，等时机到来之时再行与董卓开战不迟。”吕布始终还是喊不出“义父”这两个字。
“不可，圣上如今在董贼手中，天子蒙难，作为臣子，岂能袖手旁观，不破董贼，誓不罢兵。”虽然吕布说的很对，可一旦并州军退了，会让天下人如何看待他丁原。

content_en:
"Could it be that the General felt anxious after the Lord Governor had a falling out with the traitor Dong Zhuo? Otherwise, he wouldn't have fallen off his horse."
"Silence, the general is here, Wen Yuan, look, the general is actually smiling." Cao Xing looked at Lu Bu who was getting closer and closer with surprise. A trace of suspicion flashed in his heart. Lu Bu has always been rigorous and harsh in leading the army, especially after being ordered to Beijing with the governor, he has never seen him smile, and even Cao Xing's restless personality has restrained a lot.
"General." Zhang Liao and Cao Xing hurriedly clasped their fists.
"Oh, what are you two mumbling about here?" Lu Bu limped over with a faint smile on his face. Although his steps were a little difficult, they were still sonorous and powerful.
"General, have you recovered from your injury?" Seeing that Cao Xing did not react for a while, Zhang Liao asked hurriedly.
"It's a small injury, it's okay. Is the situation in the army okay after I was injured? You must train the soldiers as soon as possible; by the way, you must take good care of the injured soldiers." After Lu Bu explained, he walked towards the training ground.
Zhang Liao and Cao Xing looked at each other, and everyone could see the confusion in the other's eyes. Although these two people had known each other since they were pinching mud, Lu Bu had always been arrogant and invincible in their eyes, and he had a domineering air about him that he was not my opponent in the world. They were angry, and they were willing to follow Lu Bu. Unexpectedly, in just a few days, Lu Bu seemed to have changed into a different person. The previously indifferent soldier would actually intervene in person, and he became more talkative. This is great news.
However, this change was good after all. Both of them thought that after many battles, Lu Bu's character had become more and more mature. However, they did not know that although the Lu Bu in front of them still had the same body, his soul came from more than a thousand years later.
As a Chinese special forces soldier, faced with the pursuit of powerful enemies, he had no choice but to jump off a cliff. He thought he would die, but unexpectedly, by accident, he came to the most chaotic era of the Han Dynasty, and became the most powerful general Lu Bu. The excitement soon gave way to helplessness.
In terms of physical strength, there was no way he could compare to his previous life. However, thinking about the change in identity and the difference in era, guns were replaced by knives and halberds, and vehicles were replaced by war horses, he still couldn't accept it. Although the moves in Lu Bu's memory were still there, they were a bit weird in his eyes. After all, he was using such a long weapon to kill people. No, in order to get familiar with his body as quickly as possible, he tried to practice riding skills, but he didn't expect the general on the horse to run under the horse, making a big joke.
From the eyes of the soldiers he saw along the way, Lu Bu saw reverence and enthusiasm. Although the training of the soldiers seemed a bit strange to him, they were so hard and few people were lazy.
Late at night, Lu Bu held the "Spring and Autumn" that had been idle on the table in his hand, reading it with relish by candlelight. In his eyes, ancient books were too cumbersome, and it was okay to read the short stories in them for entertainment. As for the obscure parts, he filtered them out.
"General, the governor has arrived outside the tent." The guard entered the tent and whispered.
"Lord Governor." Lu Bu did not dare to neglect after hearing this and hurriedly went out to greet him.
"Fengxian, I heard from the sergeant that you were injured while riding a horse. Is it okay?" Ding Yuan asked with concern.
"It's nothing, just a minor injury. Just take a rest. It's so late, sir, haven't you rested yet?" Lu Bu still couldn't get used to the formal tone of ancient people's speech. Fortunately, Lu Bu was a military general himself, so there was nothing wrong with it to others.
Ding Yuan is about fifty years old. When he talks, he seems to have a smile on his face, giving people a sense of intimacy.
Looking at Ding Yuan in front of him, Lu Bu also had mixed feelings. In his memory, the governor treated him very well. He always worked hard to train himself and allowed him to train cavalry in the army. He was the effective second-in-command in the Bingzhou army.
"Well, tomorrow I will meet DongThere will be a fierce battle between the army and Fengxian. There is no need to participate in it. He can recover well and help his father defeat the Dong thieves later, clear the emperor's side, and strengthen the outline of the Han Dynasty. "Speaking of this, Ding Yuan's face was full of anger and a hint of expectation. For the minister, there is no greater honor than this.
"Sir, Dong's army far outnumbers our army, and it is defended by Luoyang City. Our army comes from Bingzhou. It is very inconvenient to transport food and grass. If it goes on for a long time, there may be changes. It is better to make an early decision. " Lu Bu advised.
"Oh, what should I do based on Feng Xian's opinion? "Ding Yuan's eyes lit up. In the past, Lu Bu only knew about fighting on the battlefield and training sergeants. He had never thought about such in-depth issues.
"My lord, the general believes that our army should retreat and wait until the time comes before starting a battle with Dong Zhuo. "Lu Bu still couldn't pronounce the word "adopted father".
"No, Your Majesty is now in the hands of Thief Dong, and the Emperor is in trouble. As a minister, how can I stand by and watch, and vow not to stop fighting until Thief Dong is defeated? "Although what Lu Bu said is right, once the Bingzhou army retreats, how will the world view him, Ding Yuan.
